title: Naan Mudhalvan - Engineering Hackathon
description: TANSAM successfully organized the Engineering 2025–2026 Hackathon Programme at our TANSAM premises, with a dedicated focus on Industrial IoT and Industry 4.0 technologies. The event witnessed active participation from engineering students and innovators from across Tamil Nadu. The hackathon provided a dynamic platform for solving real-time industrial challenges, fostering innovation, and encouraging collaboration between academia and industry.
